assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a 16:9 landscape location-card illustration for a voxel prison adventure game. IMAGE 1 is the factual location reference: preserve its landmarks, connected-island arrangement, materials and palette. IMAGES 2 and 3 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: borrow polished crisp voxel geometry, pixel textures, clear elevated three-quarter composition and softly modeled light; do not borrow any city buildings, roads, apartments or playgrounds. Subject: Void Fortress, suspended pale yellow-green end-stone islands in a nearly black star-speckled void. A large rectangular mine with a crisp purple purpur border and patterned yellow-green/purple blocks dominates the foreground main island; glowing short end-rod lamps line paths. Left island has the tall tapering stepped purple pagoda tower; back island has a small circular arena with dark pillars and a thin purple ring overhead; right island has clusters of tall irregular dark obsidian-like spires with violet accents. Narrow purple bridges with pale railings connect the islands. Frame closely from above at three-quarter angle, fill the frame with these actual islands and readable mine surfaces, retaining some black negative space between islands to show their floating character. Rich but restrained violet and warm pale stone, soft ambient fantasy light, sharp edges, no bloom, no haze covering details. No characters, enemies, UI, writing, logos or watermarks. No urban architecture. New illustration, not a screenshot with added overlays.
assets.visualReview: PASS: main patterned mine, pale floating islands, purple bridges/tower and ring arena match factual reference; no urban architecture or text.
